exploit_name: changeRanges silently fails when price is out of tick range
description: When the current pool price falls outside the calculated tick range, the function silently fails to create a new position and sends all liquidity to the treasury instead.
root_cause: When the current pool price falls outside the calculated tick range, the function silently fails to create a new position and sends all liquidity to the treasury instead.
fix_description: Emit an event or revert when tick range calculations fail. Provide operator override mechanisms.
notes: Protocol liquidity intended for active concentration silently exits the pool, reducing fee earning.
